title: salix pyrenaica var. ciliata
intro: Salix pyrenaica var. ciliata, commonly known as Alpine Willow, is a variety of the Pyrenees Willow (Salix pyrenaica), a shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Willow include analgesic, anti-edematous, and spasmolytic effects, which help to alleviate pain, reduce swelling, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat various conditions.
